[[India]] is a country in [[South Asia]]. It is the [[List of countries and dependencies by area|seventh-largest]] country by area, the [[List of countries and dependencies by population|most populous]] country (with over [[Demographics of India|1.4 billion people]]),{{efn|According to UN estimates, India surpassed China by the end of April 2023.<ref>{{cite news |title=India to overtake China as world's most populous country in Apr 2023 |url=https://www.un.org/en/desa/india-overtake-china-world-most-populous-country-Apr-2023-united-nations-projects#:~:text=Smith%20Mehta%2Funsplash.-,India%20to%20overtake%20China%20as%20world's%20most%20populous%20country%20in,the%20world's%20most%20populous%20country |access-date=27 April 2023 |work=[[United Nations]] |date=24 April 2023}}</ref>}} and the most populous [[democracy]] in the world.

The [[Economy of India|Indian economy]] is the world's [[List of countries by GDP (nominal)|fifth largest]] by nominal [[Gross domestic product|GDP]] and [[List of countries by GDP (PPP)|third largest]] by [[purchasing power parity]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=India |first=Forbes |date=14 June 2024 |title=The Top 10 Largest Economies In The World In 2024 |url=https://www.forbesindia.com/article/explainers/top-10-largest-economies-in-the-world/86159/1 |access-date=30 June 2024 |website=Forbes India}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=22 February 2019 |title=PM Predicts India Will Be Third-Largest Economy. He Isn't The First To Say It |url=https://www.ndtv.com/india-news/pm-predicts-india-will-be-third-largest-economy-he-wasnt-the-first-to-say-it-4248511 |access-date=30 June 2024 |website=NDTV.com |archive-date=30 June 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240630054529/https://www.ndtv.com/india-news/pm-predicts-india-will-be-third-largest-economy-he-wasnt-the-first-to-say-it-4248511 |url-status=live }}</ref> Following [[Economic liberalisation in India|market-based economic reforms]] in 1991, India became one of the [[List of countries by real GDP growth rate|fastest-growing major economies]] and is considered a [[Newly industrialized country|newly industrialised country]].
